column2:
To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], who walks the same bloody road,

[waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has dared to march on my lands. The Dark Gods watch every warband that answers a call to war, and they watch the ones who stay at home too. Bring your warriors. There will be skulls enough for both of us, and I will make sure [Root.Society.GetName] hears whose blade took the most.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], most-cunning ally-friend,

The fool-thing [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] attacks my burrows! Yes-yes, attacks ME! Come quick-quick with your claws and we will gnaw them together. The other Warlords will hear how bravely you fought at my side (or behind me, it is the same). Refuse and... I will remember. Skaven always remember.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

Oi, [Root.GetFirstName]!

Dat git [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] finks he can krump me. He's wrong. Bring yer boyz an' we'll give 'im a proper stompin'. Dere's loot in it, an' a good scrap, an' I'll tell all da ladz who smashed da most 'eads. Don't make me come over dere an' ask twice.

[waraid_ally.GetFirstName], da Boss

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], [Root.GetSisterBrother] of the Wolf,

[waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has come against me with fire and steel. Ulric despises those who sit by the hearth while their kin bleed in the snow. Ride to me with your warriors and we shall fight as the pack fights, shoulder to shoulder. When the war is done, every Warrior of Ulric from Middenheim to the Drakwald will know your name.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To the honourable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

[waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has broken the peace and marched against my lands. I call upon you, as one knight to another, to honour the oaths of our brotherhood and ride to my aid. Your deeds on the field shall be told in every chapter house of the Knightly Orders. This I swear upon my sword.

In hope of your lance,
[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], of the Warriors Guild,

[waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has marched on my hold. I have written the name in the book of grudges and I mean to strike it out in blood. Bring your axes. A dawi who helps settle another's grudge is not forgotten. The Guild will hear of it, and so will the ancestors.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

[waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has attacked my lands. A warrior's blood is not made for idleness, so I ask you to join me against my enemies. Fight well, and I will see that [Root.Society.GetName] hears of it.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]
Blood and glory! I march.
Yes-yes, I come. Quick-quick!
'Ere we go! 'Ere we go!
The pack rides together!
For honour! I ride to your side.
My axe is yours. Let the grudge be settled.
I gladly accept. May my weapon taste the blood of your enemies!
I have my own skulls to take.
Too busy-busy. Another time, yes?
Nah. Got me own scrap ta sort out.
Not this time. My own hearth needs me.
Other duties keep me from the field.
My own hold needs my axe.
I have other matters to attend to.

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], who walks the same bloody road,

I march on [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName], and the Dark Gods have promised me the walls will fall. Join the warpath. Share the slaughter, share the plunder, and share the glory when I tell [Root.Society.GetName] who stood beside me before the gates.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], most-trusted (for now) ally,

I go to take the lands of [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName]. Easy-easy conquest, yes, but more claws make it quicker. Join me and we split the spoils, fair-fair, I promise. The other Warlords will hear of your great help. Very great. Almost as great as mine.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

Oi, [Root.GetFirstName]!

I'm goin' ta krump [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName]. Gonna be a proper WAAAGH! Well, a little one. Come along wiv yer boyz. Dere's plenty of 'eads ta smash an' stuff ta grab, an' if we win I'll tell everyone ya was nearly as 'ard as me.

[waraid_ally.GetFirstName], da Boss

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], [Root.GetSisterBrother] of the Wolf,

I ride against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName], and the pack hunts best together. Join me. Ulric gives his favour to the bold, and if the hunt ends well the Warriors of Ulric will hear of your courage from my own mouth.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To the honourable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I have just cause against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName], and I go to press it with the lance. Ride with me. Should Fortune grant us victory, the Knightly Orders shall hear of your valour from my own lips.

In hope of your lance,
[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName], of the Warriors Guild,

I march on [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] to settle a grudge older than both of us. Bring your axes. If we win, the Guild will hear that you stood with me, and the book will have one line fewer in it.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I am going to war against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName], and I would have you at my side. Join me, and if we win I will see that [Root.Society.GetName] hears of your part in it.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I hear [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] begged for your sword, and you refused. Wise. The weak deserve no allies. Join me instead and we will feast on the carcass together. The Gods favour those who choose the winning side.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

The fool-thing [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] begged you for help and you said no-no. Clever! Very clever. Now help ME instead, and we will share-share the spoils. Of course we will.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

Oi!

I 'eard [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] asked ya for help an' ya told 'im ta get stuffed. Ha! Dat's da spirit. Now come an' help ME krump 'im instead. Even more fun.

[waraid_ally.GetFirstName], da Boss

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Word reached me that [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] called on you and you would not ride. Good. A wolf knows which way the wind blows. Ride with me instead, and we will share the hunt and its glory.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To the honourable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I am told [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] sought your aid and was refused. A sound judgement. My cause is the just one, and my offer is as good as any. Ride with me, and you shall have my thanks, and more besides should victory be ours.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I hear [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] asked for your axe and you kept it. Good. It would have been a shame to write your name in the book next to theirs. Bring it to me instead.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I heard that you turned down [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName]. My offer is a better one. Join me against [waraid_enemy.GetHerHim], and if we win I will see that [Root.Society.GetName] hears of your part in it.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledName]

A rider brings a letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. The war against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] is over, and we have won it.\n\n[waraid_ally.GetSheHeCap] writes that the tale of my deeds is already being told among [Root.Society.GetName], and that it grows with every telling.

A letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. The war with [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has ended in a white peace. Our enemy came for [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] lands and went home with nothing.\n\n[waraid_ally.GetSheHeCap] thanks me for standing with [waraid_ally.GetHerHim] and promises to speak well of me among [Root.Society.GetName].

A letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. The war against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] has ended in a white peace, and we have nothing to show for it but our dead.\n\n[waraid_ally.GetSheHeCap] does not blame me outright. But [waraid_ally.GetSheHe] does not thank me either, and I doubt [Root.Society.GetName] will hear my name from [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] lips.

A letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName], and it is not a kind one. The war against [waraid_enemy.GetTitledFirstName] is lost.\n\n[waraid_ally.GetSheHeCap] writes that I fought like a peasant with a pitchfork, and that [Root.Society.GetName] will hear exactly how little I did.
Victory! Let them tell the tale.
Is that all? I expected a share of the spoils.
We held. That is enough.
The nerve of this brazen fool!
What should I have done differently?
There is truth in these harsh words. I must abandon my craven ways.

Another letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. The skulls of our enemies are piled before [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] altar, and [waraid_ally.GetSheHe] invites me to the victory feast. There will be blood-wine and offerings, and champions fighting in the pit to show the Gods who is worthiest. A guest who does not fight is not a guest for long.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] invites me to a victory feast in [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] burrows. There will be warpstone-cured meat, gnawed bones and long speeches about how [waraid_ally.GetSheHe] won the war alone. There will also, very probably, be poison. One does not refuse a Warlord's feast. One also does not eat first.

[waraid_ally.GetFirstName] wants ta celebrate. Dat means a feast, an' dat means a fight, 'cos dere's no proper feast wivout one. Da ladz will all be watchin' ta see if I'm 'ard enough ta stand wiv 'im.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] invites me to a great hunt in the forests of [waraid_ally.Capital.GetName]. The Wolf God's warriors celebrate as the pack does, with a chase through the snow and a kill shared at the fire. A great boar has been seen in the woods, and whoever brings it down will be honoured above all.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] is holding a tourney to celebrate our victory, and I am invited to ride in the lists. The Knightly Orders will be watching, and so will half the realm. A good showing will be talked of for years. A bad one will be talked of for longer.

[waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] has opened the best kegs in [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] hold to toast our victory, and I am invited to drink with [waraid_ally.GetHerHim] and see the grudge struck from the book. The dawi drink to their victories as seriously as they fight for them. Leaving the table early would shame my beard.

Another letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. [waraid_ally.GetSheHeCap] invites me to celebrate our victory with feasting and contests of arms, and to show [waraid_ally.GetHerHis] court the warrior [waraid_ally.GetSheHe] has been boasting about.
To the pit! Let the Gods see me fight.
I come. But I bring my own food.
Time for a proper scrap!
To the hunt!
I shall ride in the lists.
Bring out the kegs!
I happily accept!
Decline the invitation. It is not to my taste.
I win the contest, and the respect of my host.
I come off worst.

Another letter from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. Since the celebration [waraid_ally.GetSheHe] has written often, about old battles and new enemies, and lately about less warlike things. Surely there is a reason for all this letter-writing?
Our time together is a memory I will always cherish.
I never thought I would find love through war...
My letters to [waraid_ally.GetFirstName] are nothing but formality.

They came at dusk, a band of armoured warriors with the marks of the Dark Gods burned into their shields. Their leader threw a token from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] at my feet. 'Our lord says you fought well,' he said. 'We fight for you now.' They have not asked for pay. They have asked for enemies.

A pack of clanrats crept into my burrows tonight, led by a scarred Stormvermin with a message from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. A gift, it said. Loyal warriors, it said. They are probably spies. They are certainly warriors, though, and spies who fight are still warriors.

A mob of boyz turned up at da gate, shovin' an' laughin', wiv a message from [waraid_ally.GetFirstName]: 'Dese ladz fink you'z a proper Boss. Keep 'em.' They have already eaten two goats and started a fight with my guards. They will do nicely.

A company of hard-eyed warriors in wolfskins rode in from the north today, sent by [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. They fought beside me in the last war and have asked to stay. 'The pack goes where the hunt is,' their sergeant said, and that was the end of the matter.

A company of men-at-arms and a handful of knights arrived today under the banner of [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. They bear a letter: in thanks for my valour, they are to serve me for as long as I have need of them. Their armour is battered and their lances well used. They are exactly what I need.

A column of dawi veterans marched up to my gate today, beards braided for war, carrying a sealed message from [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName]. They are to serve me, it says, until the debt of the last war is paid in full. Knowing the dawi, that may take a very long time.
A company of veterans arrived today, sent by [waraid_ally.GetTitledFirstName] in thanks for my part in the war. They have fought beside me once already, and they have asked to serve me for good.
They are welcome in my host.
Brother in Arms
